column1: # The eleven-point cube of r*(3,3): a 3-uniform family on 11 points with 28
# members, no three pairwise disjoint, point degree <= 9, pair degree <= 3?
# Deficiencies 9 - d_v sum to 99 - 84 = 15; every point used has degree >= 1
# (degree 0 is the ten-point case, closed in rstar_3_3_10.tsv); sorted, a cube
# is a partition of 15 into at most 11 parts of size at most 8: 139 cubes,
# listed most-concentrated first in rstar_3_3_11.cubes.txt.  Solver: OR-Tools
# CP-SAT via tools/cuben.py (one worker), full lex-leader prefix K = 62 per
# tools/sweep11.sh <cap> <jobs>, checkpointed: closed cubes are skipped on
# re-runs, UNKNOWN rows are the cap they ran to and are re-attempted.
# Pilot (docs/roadmap.md section 56.10): 8,7 in 0.6 s; 5,4,4,2 in 392 s;
